root_cause: Original hosted Linux failures are test deadline exceptions after 60 real seconds, not demonstrated application assertion failures or app crashes.

Pinned Compose Multiplatform 1.10.3 Skiko UI test renders every 16 virtual milliseconds. The original 360000ms modal dwell requires 22500 render passes per dwell on the default 1024x768 framebuffer despite the 360x760 child modifier.

The correction reaches a reducer-legal late-discussion state with the real bundled 180-second authored total and identity intact, then dwells 60000 virtual milliseconds, still beyond the entire remaining 30-second deadline. This avoids unnecessarily rasterizing six minutes per modal.

Explicit runSkikoComposeUiTest size now bounds the actual framebuffer to 360x760. Explicit testTimeout=60.seconds preserves the original runComposeUiTest deadline rather than accepting the Skiko overload's infinite default.
counter_evidence_and_regression_review: 30-second remaining state is produced by the real TimerTicked reducer path, not fabricated by copying canonical state. Local setup applies it before pre-existing Pause/PauseDiscussionTimer or last-second fixture actions; host setup submits after the real start barrier and asserts Success.

All ten test functions remain discoverable Unit-returning kotlin.test.Test methods. No assertion was removed; initial totalSeconds=180 and remainingSeconds=30 are asserted. The 1-second expiry edge remains covered.

Repeated Stay verifies unchanged full saved/canonical state and timer identity while covered, exact post-Stay progression, no catch-up or duplicate ticker, and unchanged private/host-only data. Existing manual/session/per-timer pause, failed-save/retry/resume, lifecycle and confirmed-leave cleanup assertions remain.

No production reducer, story, content identity/version, persistence codec, protocol or Mafia source is changed. Host test uses controlled pre-admitted transport and deliberately test-only host progression, not peer readiness or physical LAN evidence.
